p: Explain the first assignment or condition that determines the output.
Extend to output leftover bits for a non-multiple of eight.

original_exam_questions: Calculate the denary value of unsigned binary 10101010. [3 marks]
Explain why binary search requires a sorted list. [3 marks]
Midpoint comparisons only allow safe elimination of half the list when values are ordered.
Explain one advantage and one limitation of virtual memory. [4 marks]
Lets the OS accommodate memory demand beyond physical RAM; uses slower secondary storage, so paging can reduce performance.

stretch.task: Change the program to display both bits and bytes for a 2400-bit image.
stretch.hint: Keep original bits; calculate bytes separately.

mastery.task: Write a reusable converter that accepts a non-negative number of bits and reports whole bytes plus any leftover bits.
mastery.hint: DIV gives whole bytes; MOD 8 gives the remainder.
mastery.answer: For 2405 bits: 300 whole bytes and 5 remaining bits. Reject negatives; test 0,8,9,2405.
